note: What a server sends to set a champion's tallies for the scoreboard. The header names the champion.

fields.name: size
fields.note: The whole length of what follows the header, these four bytes included, in the low 16 bits; the high 16 are zero. A mismatch has no effect.

fields.name: values
fields.note: One value per tally in the client's own list of tallies, in ascending byte order of the tallies' names: a list from the client's data, one shared and one per mode. An int takes 4 bytes, a float 4, a bool 1, a 64-bit int 8, and text a 16-bit length below 255 then that many bytes. Bytes left over have no effect. A nonzero count of champion kills marks first blood taken.

fields.name: size
fields.note: How many bytes this shape occupies, counting these four.

fields.name: values
fields.note: The figures themselves. Which tally each one is, and the order they sit in, is undetermined.
